text:
alex: quick ping — can someone LGTM #4312 (tiny style + lint). want to ship this afternoon, blocking a downstream deploy.

mira: I can take a look in ~20m :ok_hand:

jon: quick skim — main issue was inconsistent var naming and a gofumpt diff. left one inline nit about `respCount` vs `response_count`.

alex: thanks. i kept it camelCase to match other functions in that file, but happy to change if consensus. also CI is failing on formatting so i think a precommit run will fix most.

sasha: i prefer snake_case for proto-derived structs, but camel is fine for internal helpers. for consistency, either change callers or add a tiny comment — whichever is less churn. :thinking_face:

mira: looks like `gofumpt` is formatting the chained calls differently. run `gofumpt -w` and push. also there's a linter warning about an unused import in `server_test.go`.

alex: cool — pushed a new commit that runs gofumpt and drops the unused import.

ci-bot: build #4312: test/format checks — failed on one flake in integration test (TestKVCacheExpiry). Retrying...

ci-bot: build #4312: test/format checks — passed

jon: code looks good now. i left a tiny docstring nit on the exported method, but it's optional. do we want me to squash commits or keep history?

alex: can squash — prefer one commit for the style sweep.

sasha: i can give LGTM after squash + rebase on main. could someone run `git rebase --autosquash` and force-push? I can grab it then.

mira: alex — if you want i can do the squash and push on your branch (i have perms). else let me know when it's rebased.

alex: i rebased and squashed, force-pushed.

sasha: ok grabbing. one sec.

sasha: LGTM. :shipit:

jon: nice. can we add a follow-up TODO ticket to standardize naming in that package? created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/issues/984 — linking in the PR description.

alex: added the issue link to PR description and enabled auto-merge. thanks all!
